title: A Gain That Knows the Pose: The Joint Control Cascade of an Arm, an Inertia That Changes Threefold With the Pose, and Gains That Follow It

artifact.note: the cascade of one arm joint: a position loop that asks for a velocity, a velocity loop with proportional and integral terms that asks for a torque (limited, with the integral held while the torque is at its limit if asked), and a current loop that is a lag; the inertia the joint sees as the diagonal of the mass matrix plus the rotor's inertia through the gear squared; gains for a wanted bandwidth that follow that inertia; and a step response run with a delay in the loop, giving the overshoot, the settling time and whether it was stable
